// A chain of straight segments in N-dimensional space. When Closed, an extra
// segment joins the last point back to the first. All points share one arity.
type PolylineN
    implements IGeometryND, IConnected, ILength
{
    Points: Array<PointN>;
    Closed: Boolean;
}
